description: This file sets up and runs a custom object detection model on a video file using the ImageAI library, specifically configuring a YOLOv3 model and performing object detection on 'holo1.mp4'.

classes.name: CustomVideoObjectDetection
classes.description: A class from the ImageAI library used for custom video object detection.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsYOLOv3
methods.description: Configures the detector to use the YOLOv3 model type.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the pre-trained model weights file.

methods.name: setJsonPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the JSON configuration file for detection.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the model into memory, preparing it for detection.

methods.name: detectObjectsFromVideo
methods.description: Performs object detection on the input video and saves the output.
